methodology.base: Same V18 source: one-year enriched pullback signals, prior-only rolling score, avoid_score4 filter, then V17 gap-aware runner exit.
removed_constraints: max 2 new entries per signal date
kept: each accepted signal is still a TWD 100,000 standard simulation unit
same fee/tax model and +0.10% adverse slippage stress used by V18+
same 10 random stock-code 60/20/20 split seeds as pullback_plus_random_splits
methodology.interpretation: This tests whether V18+'s apparent edge survives after removing capacity/portfolio selection. It is not a finite-capital executable portfolio.
